I replied to Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the Zoom Room B hub replacement is IT ticket **#4092**.

The number comes from Ilse, who wrote in #north-random on Oct 13 that the ticket was still open. Dana is in that channel, so she could have seen it herself. My reply also passed on Ilse's warning not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom.

I left out the "OPS-5546" guess Dana sent me privately. She asked me to keep it out of the channel, and it isn't a real ticket number.
